usage: agentware graph status [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                              [--node-timeout NODE_TIMEOUT] [--now NOW]
                              name

positional arguments:
  name                  graph name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --node-timeout NODE_TIMEOUT
                        per-node watchdog hours for the status view
  --now NOW             inject the clock (ISO) for a pinned status render
